title: Step
text: Generate step function, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Step time} sets the time when step occurs, {Initial value} sets the output value before step, {Final value} sets the output value after step, {Sample time} sets the sample rate, {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} treats vectors as 1-D, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Mode} sets the category of data and {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | single |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Category of data type Inherit (default) | Built in | Expression

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off
